description: NZ legislation, Hansard and bounded Parliament report archives. Living, historical, source and DOI roles differ; coverage and gates are explicit.

verified_notes.edithatogo/archive-govt-nz-global: Public ungated Parliament report batches and metadata; bounded pilot, submissions/advice blocked. See parliament/README.md.
verified_notes.edithatogo/corpus-legislation-nz: Canonical living legislation identity; selected published state, not complete legislative coverage.
verified_notes.edithatogo/corpus-legislation-nz-histori: Superseded historical operational state, retained for provenance; use living corpus for ongoing work.
verified_notes.edithatogo/nz-legislation-corpus: DOI-associated frozen snapshot; public card, gated downloads; source files preserved.
verified_notes.edithatogo/nz-hansard-corpus: Canonical document-level Hansard extract; 47–54 source coverage is partial, not complete historical Hansard.
verified_notes.edithatogo/nz-hansard-source-archive: Original DocumentsDB source ZIP; public card with gated payload; distinct from normalized Hansard.
verified_notes.edithatogo/corpus-nz-hathi: Derived historical parliamentary metadata/corpus from HathiTrust; source-specific rights and coverage.

description: NZ government, Treasury/Health, Parliament, courts, social-web and cultural archives. Source-specific rights and bounded coverage apply.

verified_notes.edithatogo/archive-govt-nz-global: Mixed preservation evidence and public Parliament report batches; source-specific rights; no full-site coverage claim.
verified_notes.edithatogo/archive-govt-nz-treasury: Treasury source/archive evidence and normalized metadata; independently maintained, source-specific eligibility.
verified_notes.edithatogo/archive-govt-nz-treasury-data: 54-row Treasury metadata Parquet derivative; convenience table, not source-original financial observations.
verified_notes.edithatogo/archive-govt-nz-treasury-csv: CSV compatibility representation of Treasury metadata; do not add to Parquet rows as new coverage.
verified_notes.edithatogo/nz-health-appropriations: Vote Health source originals and separate typed analysis/lineage tables; longitudinal expansion remains incomplete.

description: HathiTrust-NZ inventory, research plans, extracted features, analytics metadata and Parliament derivatives. Restricted full text is not implied.

verified_notes.edithatogo/hathitrust-nz-htrc-analytics: Analytics/workset plans and metadata; no claim of restricted full-text availability or complete executed analytics.
